module_summary: Edge detector wrapper: cc_sync_wedge synchronizes d_i and compares it with a delayed copy to emit rising and falling edge pulses.

anchors.name: d_i
anchors.why: Asynchronous input stream synchronized and edge-detected by the child.

anchors.name: re_o
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse on rising edge of synchronized d_i.

anchors.name: fe_o
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse on falling edge of synchronized d_i.

groups.name: sync_edge_detector
groups.description: Child synchronizer plus delay flop producing rising/falling edge pulses.
